classification.reason: Measured live against Chromium: 4.25% pixel diff, 0.0px geometry delta (both real numbers, not guesses) — proof the physical-canvas text wraps at the same logical width layout committed to, not the scaled one (see florui-paint's own scale_factor doc). Higher than the bare-element fixtures' own 3% for the same reason mixed-inline-default's own bold span is: more edge pixels for the two rasterizers to disagree on, now also at 2x resolution.
